evidence.quote: Niveau de français requis pour s'inscrire à la formation : B2

notes: Parcoursup page cites a "Niveau de français requis B2" (B2 is stated for inscription) and general admission prerequisites mentioning English; the Maroc Campus France accreditation page also shows a French certification (TCF/DELF B2/DALF) obligatoire for the Études en France procedure. Both could support a language_proficiency rule but the requirements block is omitted here because no single page states a B2 condition explicitly for non-EU applicants of this specific BUT. Tuition: the 2 902 € figure comes from the generic Campus France page for extra-communautaire students (1ère inscription en Licence), not from the programme's own page; verify the exact fee with the IUT/Études en France before relying on it. This page also does not indicate it is for the non-EU applicant specifically, so this value should be treated as a general institutional-level indicator. Teaching language is formally French (French B2 required and the programme is delivered in France).
